patch.value: Declare machine-help requiredness independently of description prose

Machine help currently infers semantic requiredness from description markers in help-json-payload.ts. A concise title-help rewrite during GH1577 kept its meaning but dropped [required], making --help --json report title.required=false; the existing regression caught it before delivery. Keep current compatibility wording for this PR and design explicit metadata as a separate improvement.

Preserve pm_help_v1 required/value-name semantics and GH441 active-mode behavior; declare semantic requiredness independently of value arity and text; prove shortening or localizing descriptions cannot alter requiredness; keep CLI/SDK/MCP discovery and fixed help budgets aligned.
Separate machine contracts from human wording so concise help, wording improvements and future localization cannot silently change agent decisions.
Requiredness comes from explicit semantic contract and active type/create-mode policy, while human descriptions can change without changing machine metadata.
